name: simple-constant-test-a426694281/simple-constant-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.string lists Char, length, indexOf, includes, substring, equalsIgnoreCaseAscii, toLowerAscii, toUpperAscii, trim, toBytes and fromBytes, but not startsWith.
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "value:toString" and "value:toBalString"
reason: Three invoked tests assert that strings:startsWith returns true for a constant, an array element initialized with that constant, and a record field initialized with that constant. startsWith is absent from the explicitly exhaustive supported ballerina/lang.string method list, so this whole case requires an unsupported langlib function even though constant declarations and the value conversion methods are supported.
test_design_notes: io:println calls serve as output instrumentation; they are not the basis of the feature classification.
